subject.title: Add gated Claw publication and validation

question: Should ClawHub adopt the proposed experimental `claw` package family and four-stage gated rollout as a repository-owned contract before any publication slice lands?
rationale: This PR changes the package-family/storage/publication boundary and is intentionally coupled to an open RFC and three open stack PRs; implementation correctness alone cannot determine whether that product surface should exist or in what merge order.

options.title: Pause for contract sponsorship
options.body: Keep the stack draft until a maintainer explicitly approves the ClawHub ownership boundary, gate semantics, and merge order.

options.title: Sponsor the staged rollout
options.body: Approve the experimental contract, require a rebased stack with live lifecycle proof, and review the slices in their documented dependency order.

recommendation.title: Pause for contract sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the stack draft until a maintainer explicitly approves the ClawHub ownership boundary, gate semantics, and merge order.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the identified author of the coordinated implementation stack and can supply the requested contract and runtime evidence.
